recognize_zh: 左側細胞比旁邊的小淋巴球大，細胞核圓形偏在一側、染色質呈粗塊狀，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色；偏心核加粗塊染色質與豐富細胞質，符合漿細胞或淋巴漿細胞樣細胞，在周邊血中出現需考慮淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤等疾病。
features: Cell larger than the adjacent small lymphocyte with a round, eccentrically placed nucleus
Coarse, clumped chromatin with small areas of parachromatin clearing; no nucleoli
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, paler than a classic plasma cell, with an indistinct perinuclear hof
Adjacent small mature lymphocyte with dense chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Background normocytic red cells without definite rouleaux; scattered normal platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells without definite rouleaux formation and adequate scattered platelets. There is a plasmacytoid cell with a round, eccentric nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin, and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm; the perinuclear hof is not conspicuous and the cytoplasm is less basophilic than a classic mature plasma cell. An adjacent small mature lymphocyte is present for comparison. Findings are consistent with a circulating plasma cell/plasmacytoid lymphocyte, which in the reported clinical context of an IgM-lambda paraprotein and marrow lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate supports lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis (viral infection, sepsis, serum sickness)
ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are polytypic on flow cytometry and resolve with the underlying illness, whereas LPL shows a light chain-restricted B-cell and plasma cell population with IgM paraprotein.
Plasma cell leukemia shows many circulating clonal plasma cells without a CD19+ B-cell component, typically with IgG/IgA or light chain paraprotein rather than IgM.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; MYD88 L265P mutation, IgM paraprotein and a diffuse marrow pattern favor LPL, while splenic or extranodal involvement and absent MYD88 favor MZL.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells with a centrally placed nucleus and more open chromatin rather than an eccentric nucleus with clumped chromatin.
